```{r}
PSymbiotic<-NULL

FSolo<-NULL
PSolo<-NULL

PDeath<-NULL
seed<-NULL

ResponseCost<-NULL
files<-gsub("0-1000000-", "0-99-", files)
files<-gsub("0-100000-", "0-98-", files)
for(i in files){

      FSolo<-c(FSolo, substr(i,123+offset,130+offset))
      PSolo<-c(PSolo, substr(i,132+offset,139+offset))
      ADeath<-c(ADeath, substr(i,141+offset,148+offset))
      FDeath<-c(FDeath, substr(i,150+offset,157+offset))
      PDeath<-c(PDeath, substr(i,159+offset,166+offset))
      Adiscount<-c(Adiscount, substr(i, 168+offset, 175+offset))
      ResponseCost<-c(ResponseCost, substr(i, 177+offset, 184+offset))
    }
    else{
      Diff<-c(Diff, substr(i, 84+offset, 84+offset))
      ASymbiotic<-c(ASymbiotic, substr(i,86+offset,93+offset))
      FSymbiotic<-c(FSymbiotic, substr(i,95+offset,102+offset))
      PSymbiotic<-c(PSymbiotic, substr(i,104+offset,111+offset))
      ASolo<-c(ASolo, substr(i,113+offset,120+offset))

files<-gsub("-99-", "-1000000-", files)
files<-gsub("-98-", "-100000-", files)
as.numeric(time)->time
as.numeric(Diff)->Diff
for (i in 1:length(Diff)){
if(Diff[i]==98) {Diff[i]<-99}
}
as.numeric(ASymbiotic)->ASymbiotic
as.numeric(FSymbiotic)->FSymbiotic
as.numeric(PSymbiotic)->PSymbiotic
as.numeric(ASolo)->ASolo
as.numeric(FSolo)->FSolo
as.numeric(PSolo)->PSolo
as.numeric(ADeath)->ADeath
as.numeric(FDeath)->FDeath
as.numeric(PDeath)->PDeath
as.numeric(Adiscount)->Adiscount
as.numeric(ResponseCost)->ResponseCost
data.frame(seed, time, Diff, ASymbiotic, FSymbiotic, PSymbiotic, ASolo, FSolo, PSolo, ADeath, FDeath, PDeath, Adiscount, ResponseCost)->ksiFrame
ksiMIN<-NULL
ksiMAX<-NULL
for(i in files){
  output<-read.csv(i, header=FALSE)
  if(!is.na(output[3])){
  c(ksiMIN,output$V1)->ksiMIN
  c(ksiMAX,output$V2)->ksiMAX
  }
  else{
    c(ksiMIN,NA)->ksiMIN
    c(ksiMAX,NA)->ksiMAX
  }
}
ksiFrame<-cbind(ksiFrame, data.frame(ksiMIN, ksiMAX))
ksiFrame<-subset(ksiFrame, !is.na(ksiFrame$ksiMIN))
ksiFrame<-subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$ksiMIN>0)
ksiFrame<-subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$PSymbiotic!=0.21)
```

Loading complete, now we plot heatmaps
```{r}
##General bookkeeping stuff
num_colors <- 128
colors <- heat.colors(num_colors)
colors <- c("black", colors)  # Add black for NA values

# Create a custom function to handle NA values
custom_col <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), 1, x+1)
}
library(fields)
```

```{r}
##AntagonistLichen heatmapping print to file
uniqueDisc<-sort(unique(ksiFrame$Adiscount))
uniqueResp<-sort(unique(ksiFrame$ResponseCost))
DvR<-array(as.numeric(c(1:5)),dim=c(length(unique(ksiFrame$Adiscount)),length(unique(ksiFrame$ResponseCost))))
for(i in c(1:length(uniqueDisc))){
  for(j in c(1:length(uniqueResp))){
    DvR[i,j]<-median(subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$Adiscount==uniqueDisc[i] & ksiFrame$ResponseCost==uniqueResp[j] & ksiFrame$time==10000)[,15])
  }
}
output_file <- "heatmapDvRA.png"
png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600)
image.plot(1:length(uniqueResp), 1:length(uniqueDisc), custom_col(t(DvR)),
           xlab = "",
           ylab = "",
           col = colors,
           axis.args = list(at = seq(min(DvR, na.rm = TRUE), max(DvR, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), labels = round(seq(min(DvR, na.rm = TRUE), max(DvR, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), 2)), axes=FALSE)
title(main = "Interaction Distance as a function
      of 1-Response Cost and Parasite growth", cex.main=1.5)
mtext(side = 1, text = "1-Response Cost", line = 4, cex = 1.8)  # Adjust 'line' to move x-axis title down
mtext(side = 2, text = "Parasite growth", line = 2.5, cex = 1.8)  # Adjust 'line' to move y-axis title right
axis(1, at = 1:length(uniqueResp), labels = uniqueResp, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
axis(2, at = 1:length(uniqueDisc), labels = uniqueDisc, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
box()
dev.off()
```



```{r}
##AntagonistLichen
# Loop through each unique value and create a plot: Resp in DvR
for (i in 1:length(uniqueResp)) {
  dummyframe <- subset(ksiFrame, 
                       ResponseCost == uniqueResp[i] &
                       time == 10000)
output_file <- paste("ADvR.Resp=", uniqueResp[i],".png")
png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 3, 10), xpd = TRUE)
  plot(dummyframe$Adiscount, dummyframe$ksiMIN,
       main = paste("1-Response cost =", uniqueResp[i]),
       xlab = "Parasite growth",
       ylab = expression("lower bound of " * xi),
       cex.main = 3, cex = 2, cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 2, col = "blue", type = "n")
  
  # Add boxplots
  medians <- numeric(length(uniqueDisc))
  colors <- character(length(uniqueDisc))
  
  for (j in 1:length(uniqueDisc)) {
    subset_data <- dummyframe$ksiMIN[dummyframe$Adiscount == uniqueDisc[j]]
    if (length(subset_data) > 0) {
      median_value <- median(subset_data)
      medians[j] <- median_value
      # Normalize the median value to a range [0, 1] for coloring (adjust as needed)
      norm_median <- (median_value - min(ksiFrame$ksiMIN)) / (max(ksiFrame$ksiMIN) - min(ksiFrame$ksiMIN))
      # Use a color ramp to get colors based on the median value
      box_color <- rgb(1 - norm_median, 0, norm_median, 0.5)
      colors[j] <- box_color
      boxplot(subset_data, add = TRUE, at = uniqueDisc[j], axes = FALSE, col = box_color, boxwex = 0.1)  # Increase box width with boxwex
    }
  }
  
  # Add a legend
  color_legend <- colorRampPalette(c("red", "purple"))(10)
  legend("topright", inset = c(-0.2, 0), legend = round(seq(min(dummyframe$ksiMIN), max(dummyframe$ksiMIN), length.out = 10), 2), 
         fill = color_legend, title = "Median Value", xpd = TRUE)
  dev.off()
}
# Loop through each unique value and create a plot: Disc in DvR
for (i in 1:length(uniqueDisc)) {

      medians[j] <- median_value
      # Normalize the median value to a range [0, 1] for coloring (adjust as needed)
      norm_median <- (median_value - min(ksiFrame$ksiMIN)) / (max(ksiFrame$ksiMIN) - min(ksiFrame$ksiMIN))
      # Use a color ramp to get colors based on the median value
      box_color <- rgb(1 - norm_median, 0, norm_median, 0.5)

      boxplot(subset_data, add = TRUE, at = uniqueResp[j], axes = FALSE, col = box_color, boxwex = .1)  # Increase box width with boxwex
    }
  }
```
